title: NaturalShrimp quarterly liquidity disclosure
summary: NaturalShrimp reported about $2.926 million of loss attributable to common shareholders for the June quarter and a $39.417 million working-capital deficit. The filing expressed substantial doubt about continuing operations and dependence on further financing.

title: Big Lots first-quarter earnings call
summary: Big Lots reported first-quarter sales down 10.2%, an adjusted net loss of $132.3 million, cash of $44 million and long-term debt of $573.8 million. Management described a new $200 million term facility and efforts to preserve liquidity.
